reviews.title: Good monitor for the price
reviews.comment: This is a good 32" 4K monitor for the price. Give an excellent image using both USB-C and HDMI. Only reason I'm marking it down one star is because it occasionally will start flickering for a while. Searching online shows this to be a common issue on this unit, apparently having to do with the monitor having difficulty locking in sync between it and the input signal. This has happened on both my former HP Envy Win 11 laptop and my current MacBook Pro; it's also happened on both USB and HDMI inputs. HP needs to fix this issue, then they'd have a 5-star product.
reviews.author: SteveC

reviews.title: Great Monitor with a built in device / network hub
reviews.comment: Very sharp image. Nice adjustable stand. AND a built in hub!! Two USB-c ports, one to go to the computer, a USB-a, and a network port. Great for a clean installation with just one cord to the laptop.
